_comment: API event definitions — QuickStay Hotels (Day 2). Create once per MID with POST /interaction/v1/eventDefinitions, then activate each Journey that consumes the event before firing production events at it. Replace every {{placeholder}} with the target MID's real values at setup time. No real credentials or Data Extension IDs belong in this file. Personal portfolio build; fictional brand.

entryDataExtensionSchema._comment: QS_Journey_Entry — the Data Extension both API events write to. In Journey Builder this schema is created/selected when the API entry source is configured on the Journey; the event's Data block may only carry fields defined here. Sendable on ContactKey. ReservationId + EventVersion are the deduplication pair described in journey-design.md.

fields.name: ContactKey
fields.note: Guest identifier — matches the contactKey used in Day 1's transactional sends for the same guest.

fields.name: ReservationId
fields.note: Part of the primary key with ContactKey + EventVersion, so an updated reservation can re-enter as a new version instead of colliding with the original row.

fields.name: EventVersion
fields.note: Booking-system version of the reservation: 1 at creation, +1 per material change (dates, property, room).

fields.name: ReservationStatus
fields.note: Confirmed | Modified | CheckedIn | CheckedOut | Cancelled — the field the cancellation exit pattern and the decision splits read.

fields.name: CheckInDate
fields.note: Anchor for the pre-arrival wait (CheckInDate minus 3 days).

fields.name: CheckOutDate
fields.note: Anchor for post-stay eligibility — the post-stay event only fires at/after this date.

fields.name: EventFiredAt
fields.note: UTC timestamp from the booking system, not the SFMC entry time — the two differ when a fire is retried, and debugging needs the source time.

entryDataExtensionSchema.name: QS_Journey_Entry
entryDataExtensionSchema.subscriberRelationship: ContactKey relates to Subscribers on Subscriber Key

eventDefinitions.description: Fired by the QuickStay booking system the moment a reservation is created or materially changed. Enters the guest into QuickStay_PreArrival_v1, whose waits anchor to CheckInDate. Fictional demo brand; personal portfolio build.
eventDefinitions.name: QuickStay — Pre-Arrival Entry

eventDefinitions.description: Fired by the QuickStay booking system when a guest checks out (ReservationStatus becomes CheckedOut). Enters the guest into QuickStay_PostStay_v1 for the feedback request. Same entry Data Extension as the pre-arrival event — one reservation field shape across both Journeys.
eventDefinitions.name: QuickStay — Post-Stay Entry
